diagnosis: In all four rollouts, the lone decision-maker satisfied check C5 by ensuring the 'accessibility_review_documented' commitment was true, despite never having access to PF4. This indicates that the check is overly permissive, allowing the model to default to documenting an accessibility review without needing the explicit information provided in PF4.

C5.why: The confirmed policy changes the approval process by requiring a documented accessibility review and a commitment that names Luis as the follow-up owner.
